# Wordwall
> Wordwall helps teachers create customizable interactive and printable classroom activities in minutes.

Wordwall is a teaching resource platform for building quizzes, matching games, word activities, assignments, and printable worksheets from reusable templates. It also hosts a large community library of ready-made activities that teachers can adapt for their own classes.

## Core Pages
- [Home](https://wordwall.net): Main product overview for creating interactive and printable teaching resources.
- [Sign up](https://wordwall.net/account/basicsignup): Create a Wordwall account and start building activities.
- [Log in](https://wordwall.net/account/login): Access an existing Wordwall account.
- [Price plans](https://wordwall.net/price-plans): Compare Basic, Standard, and Pro subscription options.
- [About](https://wordwall.net/about): Overview of how Wordwall works for teachers and classrooms.

## Getting Started
- [Create an activity](https://wordwall.net/create): Start building a new activity from a template.
- [My activities](https://wordwall.net/myactivities): Manage activities created in your account.
- [My results](https://wordwall.net/myresults): Review results from played or assigned activities.
- [Assignments](https://wordwall.net/myassignments): Manage student assignments and track participation.
- [Community activities](https://wordwall.net/community): Browse public activities shared by other teachers.

## Activity Templates
- [Quiz](https://wordwall.net/about/template/quiz): Multiple-choice question activity for review, assessment, and practice.
- [Match up](https://wordwall.net/about/template/match-up): Drag items to their matching definitions, labels, or pairs.
- [Matching pairs](https://wordwall.net/about/template/matching-pairs): Memory-style matching game for vocabulary and concept reinforcement.
- [Find the match](https://wordwall.net/about/template/find-the-match): Match prompts and answers in a fast interactive format.
- [Group sort](https://wordwall.net/about/template/group-sort): Sort words or items into categories or groups.
- [Complete the sentence](https://wordwall.net/about/template/complete-the-sentence): Fill-in-the-blank activity for grammar, vocabulary, or comprehension.
- [Anagram](https://wordwall.net/about/template/anagram): Unscramble letters to form target words.
- [Unjumble](https://wordwall.net/about/template/unjumble): Reorder words into the correct sentence sequence.

## Game and Classroom Templates
- [Spin the wheel](https://wordwall.net/about/template/spin-the-wheel): Random selector for prompts, names, topics, or rewards.
- [Open the box](https://wordwall.net/about/template/open-the-box): Reveal hidden prompts or questions one at a time.
- [Speaking cards](https://wordwall.net/about/template/speaking-cards): Prompt-based speaking activity for discussion and oral practice.
- [Flash cards](https://wordwall.net/about/template/flash-cards): Card-based review for vocabulary, facts, and recall.
- [Random cards](https://wordwall.net/about/template/random-cards): Draw random prompt cards for practice or discussion.
- [True or false](https://wordwall.net/about/template/true-or-false): Quick binary response activity for checking understanding.
- [Gameshow quiz](https://wordwall.net/about/template/gameshow-quiz): Competitive quiz format styled like a classroom game show.
- [Labelled diagram](https://wordwall.net/about/template/labelled-diagram): Label parts of an image or diagram interactively.

## Printable and Worksheet Templates
- [Crossword](https://wordwall.net/about/template/crossword): Generate crossword-style printable or interactive word practice.
- [Wordsearch](https://wordwall.net/about/template/wordsearch): Create word search activities for vocabulary review.
- [Missing word](https://wordwall.net/about/template/missing-word): Cloze-style worksheet or interactive text completion activity.
- [Maze chase](https://wordwall.net/about/template/maze-chase): Game-based activity that can be adapted from question sets.
- [Airplane](https://wordwall.net/about/template/airplane): Arcade-style game template for question-based classroom play.
- [Balloon pop](https://wordwall.net/about/template/balloon-pop): Pop correct answers in a timed game format.
- [Whack-a-mole](https://wordwall.net/about/template/whack-a-mole): Fast-response game for recognition and recall practice.
- [Hangman](https://wordwall.net/about/template/hangman): Letter-guessing activity for spelling and vocabulary practice.

## Teaching Features
- [Student assignments](https://wordwall.net/myassignments): Assign activities to students with deadlines and tracking.
- [Activity results](https://wordwall.net/myresults): View scores and participation data from completed activities.
- [Activity customization](https://wordwall.net/create): Edit themes, options, and gameplay settings for activities.
- [Switch template](https://wordwall.net/create): Reuse the same content across different activity formats.
- [Print activities](https://wordwall.net/create): Convert activities into printable worksheets and classroom handouts.

## Community and Discovery
- [Community library](https://wordwall.net/community): Search and browse millions of public teacher-created activities.
- [Featured activities](https://wordwall.net/community?orderBy=featured): Explore highlighted community activities and examples.
- [Newest activities](https://wordwall.net/community?orderBy=newest): Find recently published public activities.
- [Most played activities](https://wordwall.net/community?orderBy=mostPlayed): Discover popular activities used widely by teachers.
- [Topics](https://wordwall.net/community?query=math): Example community search for subject-specific activities.
- [Templates overview](https://wordwall.net/about/template): Browse available activity templates and formats.
